breakpoints.name: phone (Tailwind base, no prefix)
breakpoints.devices: 0-639 CSS px. iPhone SE/12/13/14/15 at 375-393, Pro Max at 430, Android phones 360-412, iPad one-third Split View (~507), and the WCAG 1.4.10 reflow test at 320. Web use here is occasional: check status, approve, look something up (mobile app is the field tool).
breakpoints.shellBehaviour: Single pane, list-first. 56px top bar (menu button 44x44, ERIS wordmark or page title, avatar menu) plus a 56px bottom navigation bar with the role's first four destinations and More (opens the full drawer). Bottom bar is shown only on top-level routes; on record/edit routes (any route with :id) the bar is replaced by a header back control and, where the page has actions, a sticky bottom action bar. Maps and 3D never sit inside the page scroll: they are a Map tab, a full-height view, or a bottom sheet. Dialogs are full-screen sheets (inset-0) with a scrolling body and pinned footer.

breakpoints.name: phablet / split-view (sm)
breakpoints.devices: 640-767 CSS px. iPad half-width Split View on 12.9-inch (678), foldables open (~717), phones in landscape (667-932 wide but only 375-430 tall). Apple HIG: defer the compact layout while the fuller one still fits, so this is a tuning band, not a new composition.
breakpoints.shellBehaviour: Same shell as phone (bottom bar + drawer, single pane). Differences: filter toolbars go to two columns (search full width on row one, controls on row two), dialogs become centered panels with max-w-xl and max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)], stat strips show three tiles per row, and card lists may show two-line rows. Landscape phones (height < 500) collapse the top bar to 48px; the bottom bar stays visible (no hide-on-scroll) and the content area is 100dvh minus both bars.

breakpoints.name: tablet-portrait (md)
breakpoints.devices: 768-1023 CSS px. iPad 9.7/10.2/10.9/11 portrait (768, 810, 820, 834), iPad two-thirds Split View (834), Surface Go and 10-inch Android tablets portrait (~800). Primary device band for engineers and coordinators in the field. Today this band gets the phone layout with the full nav card stacked above content (mainContentStartsAtPx 700).
breakpoints.shellBehaviour: Persistent labeled icon rail on the left, 80px wide (icon + 10px label, 56px-tall items, 44px hit area), sections separated by hairlines, active item filled brand with aria-current=page. No bottom bar, no stacked nav card. Header: brand mark, page title or breadcrumb, Help slot, avatar menu. Content is still ONE pane: list/detail pages show the list, tapping a row navigates to the detail route with a Back-to-list control; map pages show a Map | List segmented control. Content width is roughly 768 - 80 - 32 = 656px, enough for a 4-column table or a single-column form at 640px measure.

breakpoints.name: tablet-landscape / small laptop (lg)
breakpoints.devices: 1024-1279 CSS px. iPad landscape (1024, 1080, 1180, 1194), Surface Pro at 150%, 13-inch laptops with a side panel or at 125% zoom, browser windows tiled side by side. Today the sidebar (256px) appears here but every two-column page still waits for xl, so tablets get a sidebar plus stacked panels (My Work at 1024x768: 700px single column beside a 256px nav).
breakpoints.shellBehaviour: Same 80px labeled rail by default; the user can pin the 256px expanded sidebar (persisted in UiSettingsContext, key eris.ui.settings.v1). Two-pane compositions switch ON here (not at xl): list + detail (list 300-340px, detail the rest), map + list (map 1.4fr, list minmax(300px,1fr)). Three-region pages (list + detail + supporting pane) are not allowed yet; supporting content (map, photos, cross-section) is a collapsible edge strip or tab. Tables show their full desktop column set with sticky header and a horizontally scrollable secondary column group. Content width ~1024 - 80 - 48 = 896px.

breakpoints.name: laptop (xl)
breakpoints.devices: 1280-1535 CSS px. 13-inch laptops at 1280x800, 1366x768, 1440x900, iPad Pro 12.9 landscape (1366), 1920 monitors at 150% zoom. Primary desk device for coordinators, chiefs, reviewers, admins. Today the GISA canvas needs 1076px for two columns but only gets 1037px here, so the form runs 3,802px tall in one 520px column.
breakpoints.shellBehaviour: 256px expanded sidebar by default (collapse to the 80px rail is persisted). Header adds breadcrumb trail for record pages and the consistent Help slot (WCAG 3.2.6). Three-region pages allowed: list + detail + a supporting pane at about one-third width, or form + supporting pane (map / cross-section / photos in tabs). Queue rails become sticky and viewport-height (top = var(--header-h) + 16px, max-h = calc(100dvh - var(--header-h) - 32px)). Content width ~1280 - 256 - 48 = 976px; any grid that needs more must degrade to lg behaviour, never overflow.

breakpoints.name: monitor (2xl)
breakpoints.devices: 1536+ CSS px. 1536x864 (125% scaled 1920 monitors), 1920x1080, 2560x1440, ultrawide. Office chiefs and admins on external displays.
breakpoints.shellBehaviour: Identical composition to laptop; nothing new appears. The shell container is capped at max-w-[1600px] and centered (down from today's 1900px); text-dense pages (record lists, admin, settings, GISA read view) cap their content column at 1440px so line lengths and table cells do not stretch. Map, 3D and split-view workspaces may fill the full capped width. Extra width is spent on more table columns (column priorities reveal hidden columns) and wider supporting panes, never on wider cells or longer lines.

shell.phone: Convert AppShell to a React Router layout route (one mount, <Outlet/>) so nav state and header measurements survive navigation. HEADER (sticky top-0 z-20, height measured into --header-h with a ResizeObserver; target 56px): left = 44x44 menu button (Lucide Menu, aria-label 'Open navigation', aria-expanded) that opens a left drawer, or on :id routes a 44x44 back button whose label names the parent ('Back to My Work'); center = page title (the AppShell title prop becomes the visible h1 here, truncate, 16px semibold) with an optional one-line eyebrow for the record type ('Event Group'); right = 44x44 avatar button showing initials that opens a menu with display name, humanized role labels (roleLabel(), never enum codes), theme radio, Settings link, Sign out. The long product name and the 'Caltrans | Geotechnical Services' subtitle are not rendered below md; the logo alt text is 'ERIS'. DRAWER: fixed inset-y-0 left-0 w-[min(20rem,85vw)] z-40 panel over a scrim, built on the existing ModalDialog focus trap (Escape and scrim close, focus returned to the menu button), reusing SidebarNavigation with 48px-tall items; it lists every section so nothing is unreachable. BOTTOM BAR (top-level routes only): fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 h-14 plus pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)], z-30, five slots max: the first four entries of useNavSections() flattened in IA order (e.g. coordinator: My Work, Mission Center labeled 'Map', Event Groups, Incidents; engineer/chief/reviewer: My Work, Map, Incidents, Assessments; admin: My Work, Map, Incidents, Assessments) then 'More' which opens the drawer; each slot is icon + 11px label, min 64x56 target, aria-current=page on the active one. Maintenance reporters (Incidents + Settings only) get no bottom bar, just the header. WHERE AM I: h1 in the bar, aria-current on bottom bar and drawer, document.title = '<page> - ERIS', and record pages show the parent as the back label. Main content starts at <= 56px from the top on every route (today 700px). Body padding-bottom = bar height + safe area so content is never hidden. Workspace/map routes: no bottom bar; the map fills calc(100dvh - var(--header-h)) and the list lives in a bottom sheet or the List tab.
shell.tablet: md (768-1023, iPad portrait) and lg (1024-1279, iPad landscape). HEADER (56px, sticky, --header-h measured): brand mark + 'ERIS' wordmark linking to '/', then a breadcrumb for record pages ('Event Groups / Route 1 slide near PM 12.3') or the page title, then a persistent Help button (same slot on every page, opens a side panel with the role's 3-5 step workflow, glossary, contact), then the avatar menu (name, humanized roles, theme, Settings, Sign out). The header never shows raw role codes. NAV RAIL: <aside> fixed to the content column's left, width 80px (w-20), full content height, sticky top-[var(--header-h)]; each item is icon (20px) over a 10-11px label, 56px tall, whole item is the target, active = brand fill + white text + aria-current=page, section groups divided by hairlines with sr-only group labels. A 44x44 'Expand navigation' toggle at the top of the rail switches to the 256px labeled sidebar; the choice persists per user via UiSettingsContext. Default is the rail on md and lg because content needs the width (656px at 768, 896px at 1024). No stacked nav card, no drawer needed (the rail is always visible; NN/g: never hide navigation on tablets). CONTENT: md is single-pane (list OR detail, map OR list) with Back controls; lg turns on two-pane compositions. Page h1 sits in a 44px title row under the header on md (title left, primary page action right) and is merged into the breadcrumb row on lg+. Workspace routes (Mission Center, Terrain Cross Sections, 3D) set main to h-[calc(100dvh-var(--header-h))] overflow-hidden at md+ so the map fills the viewport beside the rail. Footer copyright is removed from app pages (kept on Login only).
shell.desktop: xl (1280-1535) and 2xl (1536+). HEADER as tablet (brand, breadcrumb/title, Help slot, avatar menu), max-w-[1600px] centered container. SIDEBAR: 256px expanded by default with section captions (Workspace / Operations / GIS Tools / Administration / Account), 40px-tall items (44px on coarse pointers via pointer-coarse:), active item brand fill + aria-current=page, a collapse toggle to the 80px rail persisted per user; sticky at top-[var(--header-h)] with its own overflow-y-auto if taller than the viewport. Optional passive count badges on My Work (items waiting on you). CONTENT: xl content width ~976px with the sidebar open, ~1152px collapsed; three-region pages allowed (queue rail 360px + detail + supporting pane), form + supporting pane (about one-third, resizable, min 320px). Queue rails are sticky and viewport-height so the detail scrolls independently while the list stays. 2xl adds no new regions: cap dense pages at 1440px measure, spend extra width on revealed table columns and wider supporting panes. Page title row: h1 (20px) left, primary action(s) right, breadcrumb above it for record pages; document.title mirrors it. Workspace routes lock main to the viewport height (h-[calc(100dvh-var(--header-h))] overflow-hidden) as today, but with the measured header variable instead of the magic top-[82px].

patterns.name: Data table (records list)
patterns.situation: Any collection users scan, sort and compare: Incidents, Event Groups, Users, Submissions worklist, Road Inventory versions, assessment submissions table. Today: 6-9 columns with no priority, 473px table in a 375px viewport (Event Groups), fixed 1200px colgroup (Submissions), actions in the last column off-screen.
patterns.phone: Card list, not a table (below the md breakpoint or when the @container is < 640px). One card per row: line 1 = primary identifier + status badge (text + color); line 2 = location or secondary key; line 3 = age/date + owner. The whole card is one link (min-h-[64px], chevron at right), no per-row chip buttons; secondary actions go into a single 44x44 overflow button. Sort is a select in the toolbar; filters behind a 'Filters (n)' sheet. Lists longer than 50 rows paginate ('Show 50 more') or virtualize. Secondary/reference tables (history, attachments, versions) may stay semantic tables with the USWDS stacked-header transformation: keep <table>, add data-label to every cell, CSS stacks cells under 640px.
patterns.tablet: Real table with column priorities from md up: every <th>/<td> carries data-priority 1-3; priority 1 (identifier, status, primary date) always visible, priority 2 hidden below @xl container (~576px content... use hidden @3xl:table-cell), priority 3 hidden below lg. Sticky header row (thead th sticky top-0 inside the table's own overflow-x-auto container, which is the ONLY horizontally scrolling element and carries tabIndex=0 and a visible right-edge fade). First column sticky-left. Actions are the second column (after identifier), never last, and rendered as 44px targets. Row height 48px (default on coarse pointers). A 'Columns' button lets the user reveal hidden priorities.
patterns.desktop: Full column set (cap 6-7 columns; move everything else into the detail pane), sticky header, sortable headers with aria-sort, density toggle (compact 32px / default 40px / comfortable 48px; 32px only offered on fine pointers), applied-filter chips with Clear all, result count in the table caption ('Showing 1-50 of 312'). Numeric columns (post mile, counts) right-aligned with tabular-nums. Selection checkboxes only on queues that have bulk actions (Calcite). At 2xl reveal priority-3 columns instead of widening cells.
patterns.source: GOV.UK table guidance (less data, split datasets); USWDS usa-table--stacked-header; NN/g mobile tables (sticky header, locked first column, column picker); IBM Carbon row sizes; Calcite table selection rules; WCAG 1.4.10 reflow (tables may scroll 2D, page must not) - brief-research responsive density track.

patterns.name: Master-detail / queue + detail
patterns.situation: A list where each item has its own meaningful detail and actions: My Work (triage + assessment steps), Assessments record view, (future) Incidents detail, Users. Today: two columns only at xl (1280); below that an 860px rail stacks above the detail and selecting a card does not scroll to it; at 1440 the rail is not sticky and the detail is 1500px+.
patterns.phone: Drill-in stack (Material list-detail compact). /my-work shows only the queue: grouped sections with counts ('Needs my decision (3)', 'Waiting on reporter (1)'), 64px+ tappable rows, sticky filter chip row under the header. Tapping a row navigates to /my-work/:itemId (URL carries the selection) which renders only the detail with a header back control 'Queue (7)'. After an action, return to the queue at the same scroll position with a success notice; never auto-select the next item. Actions on the detail live in a sticky bottom action bar (one primary + overflow), each with a confirm sheet that holds the notes field.
patterns.tablet: md (iPad portrait): same drill-in as phone but with the nav rail; the detail view gets the full 656px and a 'Back to queue' control in the title row; the list keeps its scroll position on return (restore via location state). lg (iPad landscape): two panes side by side: queue rail 300-340px (grid-cols-[minmax(300px,0.55fr)_minmax(0,1.45fr)] with min-w-0 on both) sticky at top-[calc(var(--header-h)+16px)] and max-h-[calc(100dvh-var(--header-h)-32px)] with its own overflow-y-auto; detail pane scrolls with the page. Selected row persistently highlighted (border + background + aria-current=true, not color only). The rail is the only nested scroll region on the page; the detail's History card is not capped.
patterns.desktop: Two panes from xl with rail 360px (grid-cols-[360px_minmax(0,1fr)]), rail sticky and viewport-height; optional third supporting pane (map / photos) at 2xl or when the sidebar is collapsed. URL still carries the selected id (/my-work/:itemId, /assessments/:id) so deep links, back, and refresh work identically at every size. Keyboard: Up/Down moves selection in the rail, Enter opens; rail rows are <a> or <button> in a <ul role=list>. Rail virtualizes over 200 rows.
patterns.source: Material 3 canonical list-detail layout (side by side only in expanded width); Apple HIG split views (persist selection highlight); NN/g disruptive workflow (return to the same position); Linear/Jira queue grouping - brief-research work queues and responsive tracks; live measurements /my-work and /assessments in brief-core.

patterns.name: Map + list (synchronized split view)
patterns.situation: Geographic browsing where selecting in one pane highlights the other: Mission Center (Event Groups > incidents > evidence), the triage Event Group review dialog, future incident triage with map. Today: map forced to >= 540px and placed 912px (phone) / 890px (tablet) down; list 1502px / 1644px down; side by side only at xl; toolbar overflows at 375; aside has a nested 760px scroll; popups undocked.
patterns.phone: List-first. A segmented control 'List | Map' sits sticky under the header; List is default and shows status-count chips + the card list (page scroll only, no nested scroll). Map fills calc(100dvh - var(--header-h) - 44px segmented control) with exactly one operational layer for the current level, popups docked bottom-center (popup.dockEnabled true, dockOptions.breakpoint width 768), markers enlarged 1.5x and clustered above district scale. Tapping a marker opens a non-modal bottom sheet (partial height, drag handle, close button, Back dismisses, never stacks) with ID, route/PM, status, first photo and one primary 'Open' action; the page under it is inert. Search + status filter collapse into a 44px search field and a 'Filters' sheet.
patterns.tablet: md (portrait): same List | Map segmented control as phone, map height = full content viewport, sheet for marker preview; the list view shows two-line cards. lg (landscape): side by side, map 1.4fr / list minmax(300px,1fr) (grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.4fr)_minmax(300px,1fr)]), both sized to the same --panel-h = calc(100dvh - var(--header-h) - toolbar) so map and list are always visible together; list scrolls inside its pane (the one allowed nested scroll), selecting a row pans and flashes the marker (no forced zoom), clicking a marker scrolls the row into view and highlights it. Layers/legend/basemap live in a collapsible start-side panel over the map (Calcite shell panel), not in the list column.
patterns.desktop: Same split from lg; at xl the list pane is 360-400px and the detail for a selected incident opens as a third region inside the list column (list collapses to a header with 'Back') rather than a modal. Filters (district default 'My district', route, status) are a toolbar above both panes; 'Filter list to map area' is an explicit toggle with 'Showing 12 of 87 in view'. Legend lists only visible operational symbols. Map extent never resets on polling; only on mode change. Every map view has a keyboard-reachable list equivalent.
patterns.source: Baymard split-view (65% never engage a hidden map); Esri Dashboards list-map actions and smartphone guidance (max one map, one layer); NN/g bottom sheet; Calcite shell panel / sheet; Esri clustering; W3C accessible maps - brief-research map track; live measurements /mission-center in brief-core.

patterns.name: Long form (GISA technical submission)
patterns.situation: 10+ sections, tri-state fields, measurements with units, per-section photos, map, optional 3D, filled over several sessions and reviewed read-only. Today: an absolute pixel canvas of fixed 520px cards with mouse-only drag/resize (11 screens tall on phone, 180 overflowing elements, 120 small targets; one column even at 1440).
patterns.phone: Retire the canvas. Section hub + one section per screen (GOV.UK task list): /submissions/:id is the hub listing verb-named sections with status tags (Not started / In progress / Completed / Cannot start yet), 'You have completed 3 of 10 sections', last-saved time, and the status/action bar. /submissions/:id/sections/:key renders one section in a single column (max measure 640px), fields stacked, measurement inputs as text + unit suffix + inputmode=decimal, tri-state radios stacked with nothing preselected, per-section photo block with 'Take photo / Choose'. Sticky bottom bar: Back / Save and continue (autosave chip 'Draft saved 14:32' in the header). Map and photos open as a bottom sheet from a floating button; no 3D on phones (static preview + 'Open in 3D' disabled with reason).
patterns.tablet: md: hub + one section per screen as phone, but the section page shows the section index as a horizontal scroll-snap chip strip under the header and the map/photo sheet can be taller (max-h-[60dvh]). lg (iPad landscape, the engineer's field device): single scrolling document with all sections expanded in one 640-720px column, a sticky 'On this form' section index on the left (scroll-spy, status/error badges, 44px items) and a collapsible supporting pane on the right edge (48px strip when collapsed, default collapsed while editing) holding Map / Photos / Cross-section tabs. Card heights are auto (no inner scroll). Read-only/review view is the same document fully expanded with summary rows and role-gated Change links, plus a sticky decision bar.
patterns.desktop: xl+: three regions: sticky section index (200-240px) | form column (max 720px measure, single column, auto heights) | supporting pane (~one-third, min 320px, resizable) with Map / Photos / 3D terrain tabs; 3D mounts only when its tab is opened. Validation ladder: on-blur format checks for measurements only, completeness on 'Mark section complete', cross-section checks on Submit with a linked error summary. One persistence model (autosave + visible state) and one decision flow: Submit / Approve / Return open a dialog that carries the comment. Print CSS expands everything and hides chrome; server PDF mirrors section numbering.
patterns.source: GOV.UK task list, one-thing-per-page for internal users, validation, radios, text input with suffix, check-answers; USWDS complex-form progress/keep-a-record; Baymard single-column forms; NN/g accordions and in-page links; Material supporting-pane layout - brief-research long-form and responsive tracks; live measurements /submissions/3 in brief-core.

patterns.name: Dialog / wizard / confirmation
patterns.situation: Triage (Event Group review then disposition), publish/rollback, password reset, delete, save cross section, action confirmations (Delegate, Approve, Finalize). Today: 92vh panel with a 52vh list, a 380px map and the body all scrolling separately; three footer buttons that do not wrap at 375; dialogs without max-height clip on short viewports.
patterns.phone: Full-screen sheet: fixed inset-0, flex-col, header (title + 44x44 close), body overflow-y-auto with pb-safe, footer pinned (flex-col-reverse gap-2, primary first in DOM, every button w-full min-h-11). Multi-step flows use a step indicator in the header ('Step 1 of 2 - Location') with Back always available and one primary per step. Maps inside dialogs become a 'Map' step or an in-dialog List | Map segmented control sized to the body height, never a fixed 380px block inside a scrolling body. Errors render inside the dialog above the fields (role=alert), never in the page banner behind the scrim. Scrim taps do not dismiss when the form is dirty.
patterns.tablet: Centered panel from sm: w-full max-w-xl (confirmations), max-w-3xl (forms), max-w-5xl (map dialogs); max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] with the same header/body/footer structure and internal body scroll. Map dialogs use md:grid-cols-[minmax(260px,0.9fr)_minmax(0,1.2fr)] at md+ with the map height derived from the panel (aspect-[4/3] max-h-[50dvh]), popups docked. Footer buttons in a row from sm with the destructive/back action on the left.
patterns.desktop: As tablet; add the ModalDialog defaults max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto to the primitive so no consumer can clip. Confirmations name the object and consequence ('Delegate Assessment #12 (Incident #40, R001 PM 12.3) to J. Smith? They will be emailed and it leaves your queue.'), initial focus on Cancel for destructive ones, and carry the optional note textarea so it is next to the action. Wizards only for infrequent linear flows (triage, first incident report), never for the GISA.
patterns.source: NN/g wizards and bottom sheets; USWDS step indicator; NN/g error-message placement; GOV.UK validation; existing ModalDialog focus-trap strengths in brief-screens; ModalDialog and triage dialog responsive issues in brief-core My Work audit.

patterns.name: 3D scene (ArcGIS SceneView)
patterns.situation: Measurements card terrain scene on the submission page and the Terrain Cross Sections workspace. Today: a qualityProfile-high SceneView auto-mounts for every role inside a 520x980 scrolling card (nested gesture trap, 9-10px controls); the cross-section toolbar width collapses to 0 at 375 and the workspace is a 620px box in a scrolling page.
patterns.phone: Never auto-load 3D. Show a static preview image (server-rendered or last capture) with an 'Open 3D terrain' button that is disabled with a visible reason when WebGL2 or device memory (navigator.deviceMemory < 4) fails the gate. When opened, the scene is a full-screen route/overlay (fixed inset-0 under the header, 100dvh) with a 56px top bar (Back, title) and a bottom action bar of 44px buttons; panels (profile, points, setup) are bottom sheets max-h-[70dvh] with a drag handle; the profile chart is tap-to-pin and arrow-key steppable. Basemap and DEM overlays go inside the Setup sheet.
patterns.tablet: md: same full-screen-on-demand rule as phone (a 3D scene is never inside a scrolling page). lg: the Terrain Cross Sections workspace fills h-[calc(100dvh-var(--header-h))] beside the rail; toolbar is a single-row bottom action bar (primary 'Build profile', secondary New/Undo/Add points, overflow menu for Save/Capture/Clear/DEM/Full screen) instead of max-w-[calc(100%-360px)]; the profile docks as a bottom drawer (h-[280px]) spanning the map width so terrain stays visible; view.padding accounts for the drawer before goTo. qualityProfile 'medium' on coarse pointers with an Auto/Low control. Inside the GISA form the 3D lives in the supporting pane's 3D tab, mounted on demand, sized to the pane.
patterns.desktop: Workspace fills the viewport; toolbar top-left as a compact 44px-tall bar with the same primary/secondary/overflow grouping; profile bottom drawer; points/setup as a right-side panel that never exceeds 360px and can be closed; DEM legend shrunk to 4 classes and only while the overlay is on. On the submission page the 3D tab in the supporting pane mounts on click (never on load), with a 'Load 3D terrain' button, a 30s timeout and a 2D map + static cross-section fallback. Global rule stays: no position/z-index on .esri-view; wrap scenes in .map-stack-guard.
patterns.source: Esri SceneView system requirements (WebGL2, 6GB RAM, qualityProfile); brief-research map track 'progressive 3D'; Calcite shell/sheet; Terrain Cross Sections and Measurements card audits in brief-core and brief-screens.

patterns.name: Filter toolbar
patterns.situation: Search + status/state + district/office filters + count + refresh above every list. Today: flex-wrap rows that wrap into 3-5 lines on phone (Incidents filter row 90px tall at 768; 4-5 rows at 375), 220-280px min-widths that overflow a 277px content width, counts duplicated.
patterns.phone: Row 1: search input full width (min-h-11, type=search, clear button). Row 2: 'Filters (n)' button (opens a bottom sheet with all selects as 44px radio/checkbox rows and Apply/Clear) + sort select + primary page action; no inline selects. Applied filters render as removable chips under the rows with Clear all. Count moves into the list header ('12 awaiting intake'). Refresh becomes a 44x44 icon button, or is dropped where data auto-reloads. Tabs (Incident records / Awaiting intake) become a full-width segmented control with counts, 44px tall.
patterns.tablet: Grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] at sm+: search on the left (min-w-0, flex-1), a right group of at most two selects (min-w-0, 44px on coarse) and the action; anything beyond two filters stays behind the Filters button. Applied-filter chips row below. At lg the Filters button can expand into inline selects when the container is >= 880px (@container query on the toolbar, not the viewport).
patterns.desktop: Single row: search (max 480px), 3-4 inline selects with visible labels, density toggle, primary action right-aligned; applied chips below with Clear all; result count in the table caption. Filter state mirrors into the URL (useSearchParams) so Back/refresh/share keep it. Never a checkbox floating in the toolbar; boolean filters are toggle chips with the on-state named ('Unassigned only').
patterns.source: Baymard filtering (applied-filter overview, Clear all, multi-select); NN/g toggle switch; Calcite action bar limit (five toolbar actions); Incidents/Event Groups/Assessments toolbar measurements in brief-core.

patterns.name: Photo grid / evidence library
patterns.situation: Submission library tiles, section attachments dialog, photo evidence page, Mission Center photo rows. Today: hover-only Open/Download overlays (24px), a viewer that replaces the grid with no next/previous, PDF iframe dead end on iOS, evidence page duplicating the library with no map.
patterns.phone: Two-column tile grid (grid-cols-2, aspect-[4/3], gap-2); each tile is one 44px+ target that opens a lightbox (full-screen, swipe + arrow keys for previous/next, thumbnail strip, metadata drawer with section, captured time, Mapped/Heading badges, Open original / Download buttons). Actions never hover-only (@media (hover:none) already shows them; make them always visible everywhere). Section chip on its own footer line, file name wraps to two lines. PDFs open in a new tab on touch with a visible 'Open PDF' button instead of an iframe. Filter pills (All / Photos / Videos / Documents) as a 44px segmented control on its own row.
patterns.tablet: Grid auto-fill minmax(160px,1fr) (3-4 per row at 656-896px); same lightbox; in the GISA supporting pane the grid is 2-up. Photo evidence becomes a mode of the library (telemetry badges on the same tiles) with a compact map above the grid showing numbered pins with heading wedges; tapping a pin highlights the tile and vice versa.
patterns.desktop: Grid auto-fill minmax(200px,1fr); lightbox with keyboard navigation; map + tiles side by side in the supporting pane (map 40% / tiles 60%). Per-section photo blocks sit next to the question they evidence in the form; the library is the union view. All URLs go through the presigned resolver with refresh on error.
patterns.source: Esri Field Maps attachments in forms; NN/g tooltips (never essential); WCAG 2.5.8; Submission library and photo evidence audits in brief-core and brief-screens.

patterns.name: Detail / record header
patterns.situation: Top of Event Group detail, submission detail, assessment detail, incident detail: identity, status, key facts, actions. Today: flex-wrap action clusters of 5-6 buttons that wrap to 2-3 rows at 375 (submission header), meta lines that wrap to three lines, 'Open Event Group' style chips at 22px.
patterns.phone: Header block = eyebrow (record type + id, 12px), title (18px, wraps), status badge (text + color), one key-facts line that wraps (location, date). Actions: exactly one primary in a sticky bottom action bar (min-h-14 plus safe area) with a 44x44 overflow menu for the rest; cross-links (Open incident, Map, Event Group) become a horizontal scroll-snap chip row of 44px chips. Back control in the app bar names the parent. No Refresh button (pull-to-refresh not implemented; a Refresh entry in overflow).
patterns.tablet: Header card: title block left, key facts as a two-column <dl> right (flex-wrap, dl becomes single row of chips below sm); action row right-aligned with primary + up to two secondaries + overflow; sticky at top-[var(--header-h)] only for edit/review pages (decision bar). Breadcrumb in the app header carries the parent.
patterns.desktop: Same card; primary + secondaries visible (max four before overflow), status badge beside the title, key facts dl in up to four columns, meta line 'Updated 6 days ago' with title attribute AND visible relative time. Reviewer/engineer decision inputs (comment) live in the action's dialog, not at the page bottom.
patterns.source: Apple HIG (actions in toolbars, not tab bars); NN/g visibility of system status (stage badge + age); GOV.UK summary list; detail header audits (SubmissionDetailHeader, EventGroupDetailPage) in brief-core.

patterns.name: Status pipeline / timeline / history
patterns.situation: Six-step assessment pipeline, workflow history, event group history, workflow events. Today: pipeline needs ~504px (6 x 74px + connectors) inside 311px and scrolls sideways with no hint; history in a nested max-h-[420px]/[520px] scroll; current step conveyed by color only; reviewer comments buried in history.
patterns.phone: Pipeline collapses to a single line 'Step 3 of 6 - Engineering (with J. Doe since Sep 2)' with a 44px 'Show all steps' disclosure that renders a vertical stepper (left border connector, done/current/pending glyph + text, aria-current=step). The latest actionable comment (reviewer note on Returned) is quoted in the Next-step card, not only in history. History renders in page flow (no nested max-height); long histories collapse to the last 5 events with 'Show all 23'. Timestamps show visible relative time plus a <time> with the full value.
patterns.tablet: Vertical stepper below md (flex-col), horizontal from md when the container is >= 600px (@container) with min-w-[56px] steps and text under the dots; history as an in-flow list, collapsed to recent events by default; nested scroll only allowed inside a sticky rail.
patterns.desktop: Horizontal pipeline with per-step timestamps and owners from the API fields (office_delegated_at, engineer_assigned_at, submitted_at, ...), current step ringed + labeled; history as a two-column dl or timeline in page flow; the Next-step card always precedes it. Status vocabulary is one governed set of plain-language labels with fixed colors and text, never enum codes.
patterns.source: NN/g visibility of system status and heuristic 2 (plain language); USWDS step indicator (aria-current); brief-research learnability track (next-step banner, governed status tags); AssessmentDetailPanel pipeline measurements in brief-core.

patterns.name: Supporting pane (reference content beside primary work)
patterns.situation: Map, photos, cross-section, road-inventory snapshot that only make sense next to the form or the queue item being worked (GISA form, triage panel, assessment work panel). Today: a 360px map hero above the form (726px tall on iPad portrait), 3D inside a card, evidence on a separate page.
patterns.phone: Floating 'Map' / 'Photos' buttons (44x44, bottom-right above the action bar) open a non-modal bottom sheet (snap points 40% / 90%, drag handle, close button, Back dismisses, never stacked); the primary content stays scrollable behind at the 40% snap. Maps inside the sheet are sized to the sheet and use docked popups.
patterns.tablet: md: same sheet approach. lg: right edge strip 48px wide with vertical icon tabs (Map / Photos / Cross-section); tapping opens the pane to 320-360px pushing (not overlaying) the primary column; default collapsed while editing the GISA, default open while reviewing.
patterns.desktop: Persistent right pane at about one-third width (min 320px, max 480px, user-resizable with a 44px-wide drag handle plus keyboard Left/Right), tabs for Map / Photos / 3D / Road inventory; content mounts lazily per tab. Pane state (open, width, tab) persists per user.
patterns.source: Material 3 supporting-pane canonical layout; Calcite shell panel; NN/g bottom sheet; brief-research responsive track 'supporting pane -> bottom sheet'.

touchRules: Target size: every interactive element is at least 24x24 CSS px with 8px spacing everywhere (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 AA floor), and at least 44x44 CSS px (hit area, not necessarily the glyph) when the pointer is coarse: implement with Tailwind v4 variants `pointer-coarse:min-h-11 pointer-coarse:min-w-11` on Button, nav items, table row actions, sort headers, chips, checkboxes/radios (wrap in a 44px label), map toolbar buttons, tile actions, sheet handles. Default row height 48px on coarse pointers, 40px on fine.

Text size: no essential text below 12px anywhere (today 23-74 leaf nodes per page are under 12px); body 14px, table cells 13-14px, eyebrows 11-12px uppercase only for non-essential labels; 3D/map overlay controls at least 12px text with 44px targets on coarse pointers.

No hover-only affordances: anything revealed on hover (tile Open/Download, chip title tooltips with raw codes, row highlight, link color change, drag hints) must be visible or reachable by tap/focus. Links are underlined (decoration-[var(--line)] underline-offset-2) not color-only; row cards get active:bg-[var(--panel-soft)] and a chevron; Tailwind v4 already scopes hover: to (hover:hover), so never rely on it for state.

Selected/active state is never color alone: aria-current=page (nav), aria-current=true (selected row), aria-pressed (toggle chips) plus a visible check glyph or 2px brand border in addition to the tint.

Drag always has a tap alternative: the GISA canvas drag/resize is removed; cross-section control points can be removed/zoomed from the Points list and reordered with Up/Down buttons in addition to on-map drag (SketchViewModel); supporting-pane resize handle is 44px wide and also responds to ArrowLeft/ArrowRight; any future drag-and-drop uses Pointer Events, a 44px handle that does not look like a menu icon, and a visible move-to menu.

Sheets: bottom sheets have a 44px-tall drag handle region, a visible close button, snap points (40% / 90% for supporting content; 70dvh max for panels), dismiss on Back (history entry) and on Escape, never stack (opening a second replaces the first), never hold long forms or approvals (short interactions only), and lock the page scroll while at the tall snap. Full-screen sheets on phones have header (title + 44x44 close) / scrolling body / pinned footer with w-full buttons, primary first in DOM using flex-col-reverse.

Maps and 3D never sit inside the page scroll on phones: they are behind a List | Map segmented control, in a bottom sheet, or a full-height view; where a map must appear inline (lg+ split views, tablet dialogs) it is sized to the pane (aspect or dvh based), popups are docked (dockEnabled true, breakpoint width 768, bottom-center), markers are 1.5x on coarse pointers, and a synchronized list is always the accessible equivalent path.

One scroll region per screen outside the page scroll: only a sticky rail (lg+), a sheet body, a dialog body, or a table's horizontal wrapper may scroll independently; no max-h-[420px]/[520px]/[760px]/[860px] nested lists; any allowed scroll container carries tabIndex=0, a visible edge fade, and data-scroll-region so tests can allowlist it.

Sticky action bars: on phones every edit/review/decision page has exactly one primary action in a fixed bottom bar (min-h-14 plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) with an overflow menu for secondaries; the bottom navigation bar is hidden on those routes so bars never stack. Content gets padding-bottom equal to the bar height.

Confirmations for irreversible or notifying actions (Delegate, Assign, Approve, Return, Finalize, Publish, Rollback, Disable, Delete, Clear points) open a dialog/sheet that names the object and consequence and carries the optional note; the primary button is disabled while in flight; initial focus lands on Cancel for destructive actions; a persistent success notice follows and the view does not jump to a different record.

Form inputs on touch: min-h-11, 16px font on phones (avoids iOS zoom), type=text inputmode=decimal for coordinates and measurements (never type=number spinbuttons), type=date/datetime-local where native pickers help, autocomplete tokens, no validation on keystroke, errors adjacent to fields with role=alert summary on submit, and inputs never disabled during saves.

Reflow: at 320 CSS px width (or 400% zoom on desktop) the header, filters, search, form fields, dialogs and cards must not require horizontal scrolling; only whole tables (inside their wrapper) and maps may scroll horizontally, and both must be reachable and operable by keyboard.
implementationNotes: Breakpoint tokens: keep Tailwind v4 defaults (sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536) so existing classes stay valid; document the five ERIS names against them in web/src/index.css comments and export the same numbers from web/src/ui/breakpoints.ts (BREAKPOINTS = { sm: 640, md: 768, lg: 1024, xl: 1280, '2xl': 1536 }) for matchMedia hooks (useBreakpoint()) used by ArcGIS sizing and List | Map controls. Never key layout to user-agent or device names; always the viewport or the container.

Container queries for panel-internal layout: put `@container` on the detail pane, supporting pane, dialog body, toolbar and table wrapper, then size children with `@sm:` / `@md:` / `@lg:` / `@xl:` / `@3xl:` variants (Tailwind v4 built-in, sizes 3xs=16rem ... 7xl=80rem); e.g. pipeline `flex-col @2xl:flex-row`, submissions table `hidden @3xl:table-cell` for priority-2 columns, toolbar inline selects `hidden @4xl:flex`. A pane's own width, not the viewport, decides these because the sidebar can be pinned or collapsed.

Flex/grid overflow hygiene: every flex child that holds text or a table gets min-w-0; grid columns use minmax(0,1fr) never bare 1fr; remove fixed min-widths that exceed ~277px (min-w-[280px] search, min-w-72 package card, min-w-[520px] chart) in favour of w-full min-w-0 at the base and the fixed width only from the breakpoint where it fits (lg:w-72). Add `overflow-x-hidden` only to the page root as a guard, never to hide a real overflow.

Viewport units: use dvh not vh for anything that must fit with the mobile URL bar and keyboard (`min-h-dvh`, `h-[calc(100dvh-var(--header-h))]`, `max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)]` on ModalDialog panels, `max-h-[70dvh]` on sheets); keep `min-height: 100vh` on html/body/#root replaced by 100dvh in index.css. Add `<meta name=viewport content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover'>` in web/index.html and pad fixed bottom bars with `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]`, fixed sheets with `pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]`.

Header height variable: measure the header with a ResizeObserver in AppShell and write `--header-h` on documentElement (fallback 56px); use `top-[var(--header-h)]` for the rail/sidebar, sticky sub-toolbars and segmented controls, `scroll-mt-[calc(var(--header-h)+8px)]` on deep-linked rows/sections, and `h-[calc(100dvh-var(--header-h))]` for workspace mains. Delete the magic `top-[82px]`.

AppShell as a layout route: `<Route element={<AppShell/>}>` with `<Outlet/>` and a small context (setTitle, setBreadcrumb, setPrimaryAction) or route handle data so pages declare title/breadcrumb; persist navExpanded, density and supporting-pane state in UiSettingsContext (eris.ui.settings.v1); render bottom bar only when the matched route has handle.topLevel; render the drawer with the existing ModalDialog focus-trap logic (inset-y-0 left-0 panel variant).

Coarse-pointer and hover variants: Tailwind v4.1 provides `pointer-coarse:` / `pointer-fine:` / `any-pointer-coarse:`; use them for target sizes and density defaults, and remember `hover:` is already wrapped in @media (hover:hover) in v4, so touch devices never see hover styles - every hover affordance needs a base or focus-visible equivalent. Add `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--brand)] focus-visible:outline-none` to Button, NavItem, rail cards, tiles, chips.

Shared primitives (web/src/ui): Button (variant, size; min-h-10 base, pointer-coarse:min-h-11), IconButton (44px), Badge/StatusPill (tone + text, non-interactive), SegmentedControl (role=tablist or radiogroup, 44px), Sheet (bottom sheet with snap points built on ModalDialog), Drawer, ActionBar (sticky bottom), ResponsiveTable (data-priority columns, sticky header/first column, card mode below @2xl container via a `stacked` prop that emits data-label), ListDetailLayout (drill-in below lg, two panes at lg+, URL-driven selection), SplitMapLayout (List | Map control below lg, grid at lg+, --panel-h), SupportingPane (sheet / edge strip / pane), Toolbar (search + Filters sheet + chips), PageHeader (breadcrumb, h1, actions). Replace the copy-pasted rail/detail scaffold in MyWorkPage.tsx:136-142 and AssessmentWorkspacePage.tsx:120-123 with ListDetailLayout.

Tables: `<div class='@container overflow-x-auto' tabindex=0 data-scroll-region>` wrapper is the only horizontal scroller; `thead th { position: sticky; top: 0 }` inside it; first column `sticky left-0 bg-[var(--panel)]`; column priority via `data-priority` + classes `hidden @3xl:table-cell` (priority 2) and `hidden @5xl:table-cell` (priority 3); actions column placed second; density via `data-density` attribute on the table setting `--row-h` (32/40/48px) consumed by `td { height: var(--row-h) }`. Cap 6-7 columns; the rest goes to the detail pane.

Virtualization: use @tanstack/react-virtual for the My Work rail, Assessments rail, Event Groups and Incidents lists when items > 200 (queues fetch up to 1000 today); fixed row heights per density make estimates exact; keep semantic <ul>/<table> roles with aria-rowcount/aria-setsize. Prefer server-side paging/filtering (listAssessments params, /submissions/page cursor) so virtualization is the fallback, not the plan.

ArcGIS sizing and gestures: pass map heights as CSS classes/variables (`h-[40dvh] md:h-[50dvh] lg:h-[var(--panel-h)]`), not fixed pixel props; set `view.popup.dockEnabled = true` with `dockOptions: { breakpoint: { width: 768 }, position: 'bottom-center' }`; enlarge symbols 1.5x when matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)') matches; set `view.padding` before goTo when a drawer/pane overlaps; below md load only Home/Locate/Sketch widgets and register the Expand control via view.ui.add; never put position/z-index on .esri-view (keep the isolation-only rule) and wrap every view in .map-stack-guard; SceneView qualityProfile 'medium' on coarse pointers, mount on user action, gate on WebGL2 + navigator.deviceMemory >= 4 with a 30s timeout fallback.

Sticky elements and z-index scale: header z-20, sticky sub-toolbars z-10, rail/sidebar z-10, bottom nav z-30, drawer/sheet z-40, ModalDialog z-50, full-screen 3D z-[60]; maps isolate their own stacking so they never escape. Only one sticky bar under the header per page (segmented control OR toolbar), 44px tall.

Typography and density tokens in index.css: `--text-min: 12px`, `--row-h` per density, `--measure: 72ch` for form columns (max-w-[720px]), content cap `max-w-[1600px]` on the shell container and `max-w-[1440px]` on dense text pages via a `page-measure` utility; keep the existing color tokens and themes untouched.

Motion and reduced motion: sheet/drawer transitions 160-200ms, `motion-reduce:transition-none`; no auto-scroll surprises: scrollIntoView only after user selection, with `block: 'start'` and header offset via scroll-mt.
Print: `@media print` hides header, rail, bottom bar, sheets, expands all sections and tables (no priorities), 12pt minimum, repeats table headers; used by the GISA read view.

Deprecations to delete once the patterns land: submissionLayoutModel.ts canvas math and useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts (drag/resize/localStorage layout), the stacked `aside lg:hidden` nav card in AppShell.tsx:164, max-h-[860px]/[760px]/[520px]/[420px] nested scroll caps, min-w-[74px] pipeline steps, the max-w-[calc(100%-360px)] toolbar in TerrainCrossSectionWorkspace.tsx, the fixed 1200px colgroup in SubmissionsWorklistPage.tsx, raw role codes in the header (AppShell.tsx:157) replaced by roleLabel().
testing: Tooling: add @playwright/test and @axe-core/playwright to web/devDependencies with playwright.config.ts projects per viewport; run against the seeded local backend (same seed used for the brief's measurements) with one storageState per role (coordinator, office chief, branch chief, engineer, reviewer+admin, maintenance reporter).

Viewport matrix (CSS px, all as Playwright projects): 320x568 (reflow floor), 375x812 iPhone (hasTouch, isMobile, deviceScaleFactor 3), 390x844, 430x932, 667x375 phone landscape, 507x1024 iPad one-third Split View, 678x1024 iPad half Split View, 768x1024 iPad portrait (hasTouch), 834x1194 iPad Air portrait, 1024x768 iPad landscape (hasTouch), 1194x834 iPad Pro 11 landscape, 1280x800 laptop, 1366x768, 1440x900, 1536x864, 1920x1080. Touch projects use pointer: coarse emulation so pointer-coarse: styles are exercised.

Route matrix: /login, /my-work (queue) and /my-work/:itemId (one triage, one assessment), /assessments and /assessments/:id, /incidents, /incidents/:id, /incidents/new, /event-groups, /event-groups/:id, /mission-center, /mission-center/:gid, /mission-center/:gid/:iid, /gis/terrain-cross-sections, /submissions, /submissions/:id (hub) and one /submissions/:id/sections/:key, /submissions/:id/photo-evidence, /admin/users, /admin/road-inventory, /settings, a 404 URL; plus opened dialogs: triage step 1 and 2, publish confirmation, password reset, save cross section, delete submission.

Fixture measureLayout(page) ports the brief's DOM script and returns { mainContentStartsAtPx (top of <main> first content child), screensTall (document.scrollHeight / innerHeight), horizontalOverflow (documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth), overflowingElements (elements whose getBoundingClientRect().right > innerWidth + 1, excluding descendants of [data-allow-overflow]), interactive count, smallTapTargets (interactive elements with width or height < 24, and < 44 on touch projects, excluding sr-only and inline text links inside paragraphs), tinyTextNodes (leaf text nodes with computed font-size < 12px), nestedScrollRegions (elements with overflowY auto/scroll and scrollHeight > clientHeight, excluding [data-scroll-region] and dialogs) }.

Assertions per route and viewport: horizontalOverflow === false and overflowingElements === 0 on every project including 320 wide (tables and maps wrapped in [data-allow-overflow] are the only exceptions); mainContentStartsAtPx <= 64 below md and <= 120 at md+ (today 700); smallTapTargets === 0 on touch projects and no target under 24px anywhere; tinyTextNodes === 0 for essential text (allowlist aria-hidden decoration); nestedScrollRegions === 0 below lg and <= 1 (the sticky rail) at lg+; screensTall <= 2 for list views at 375 and <= 4 for the GISA hub.

Composition assertions: below lg on /my-work, /assessments, /mission-center exactly one of [data-pane=list] / [data-pane=detail|map] is visible and the other is not rendered; at lg+ both are visible with their top within the first viewport (rect.top < innerHeight * 0.4) and the rail's bottom <= innerHeight (sticky viewport-height); on /mission-center at lg+ map and list rects both intersect the viewport at load; bottom navigation is present on top-level routes below md and absent on :id routes and workspace routes; the drawer traps focus and returns it to the menu button.

Header variable and sticky offsets: assert getComputedStyle(documentElement).getPropertyValue('--header-h') equals the header's measured height after a resize (resize the viewport mid-test and re-check), and that the first sticky element under the header has top === header height.

Form and dialog checks: on 375x812 and 667x375 open every dialog and assert its footer primary button is within the viewport without scrolling the page (rect.bottom <= innerHeight) and the body scrolls internally; with the virtual keyboard simulated (resize viewport height to 400) the focused input and the primary action remain visible; the sticky action bar on section pages is within the viewport at all scroll positions.

Map and 3D checks: on touch projects assert no ArcGIS view is inside a scrolling ancestor other than the page-level pane (walk parents for overflow auto/scroll); popups have dockEnabled true and dock position bottom-center below 768; the 3D scene is not mounted at load (no .esri-view inside [data-scene]) on phone projects and mounts after the gated button; SceneView never receives position/z-index from app CSS (assert computed position of .esri-view is 'static' unless ArcGIS set it).

Accessibility: run axe (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag22aa tags) on every route and viewport, fail on any violation; keyboard walk: Tab order reaches every visible action, arrow keys move selection in rails, Escape closes sheets/drawer/dialogs and returns focus; check aria-current on nav and selected rows, aria-pressed on chips, aria-sort on sortable headers, role=alert on error banners; contrast is covered by axe using the three themes (run the matrix in light and dark at minimum).
Visual regression: toHaveScreenshot per route x viewport x theme committed as baselines, masked for timestamps and map tiles; PR diffs must be reviewed for layout regressions, not just pixels.

Performance budgets on phone projects: no layout shift after load (CLS < 0.1 via web-vitals), main thread idle before the first tap; lists over 200 rows must render <= 60 DOM rows (virtualization check via querySelectorAll('[role=row], li').length).

CI: run the matrix on every PR touching web/src/ui, web/src/features/**, or web/src/index.css; upload the measureLayout JSON per route/viewport as an artifact so the numbers can be compared against the brief's baseline (phone /my-work 700 -> <= 64, /submissions/3 screensTall 11.1 -> <= 4, /incidents overflowingElements 67 -> 0, /mission-center list top 1502 -> visible on the List tab at 0 scroll).

Manual device pass before release: iPad (portrait and landscape, Split View one-third/half/two-thirds, Stage Manager) and one iPhone and one Android phone in Safari/Chrome, checking safe-area padding, dvh with the URL bar, keyboard overlap, ArcGIS touch pan inside List | Map and sheets, and glove-friendly targets on the GISA section pages.
